workItems.title: [Report Designer] Support Range links (Date Range, Formula Range)
workItems.description:
As a Report Author
I want to link Date Range and Formula Range content into my report template
So that the report can display computed/structural content (like a date series or formula-derived summary) rather than a single variable's value

Size estimate: TBD � shell created for estimation; Formula Range portion blocked pending investigation
Sequencing note: None for Date Range. Formula Range is blocked � see open question below.

Requirements

Conceptual distinction from variable linking
Ranges (Date Range, Formula Range) add content to the report rather than mapping a single variable's value into a cell � this is distinct from the variable linking mechanism covered in 1869322.

Date Range link
Author can create a Date Range link (WPF: Ranges > Date Range > Link), producing a range of row/column labels tied to the report run period (e.g. Total/2020/2021 rows generated from a linked range). Variable Type for a Date Range link is "Periodic Date". Confirmed working example: Range =Sheet1!$C$24:$C$26 produces Total/2020/2021 labels referenced by Periodic Links elsewhere in the template.

Formula Range link � open question, functionality not yet understood
Web Report Designer must also support Formula Range links (WPF: Ranges > Formula Range > Link), producing <SUMMARY>, <FIRST VALUE>, and <SECOND VALUE> placeholders. It is unclear whether Formula Range ties to a spreadsheet formula's output, an auto-derived calculation over a range (e.g. min/max or start/end of a series), or something else. Neither Marg nor Claude could determine this from UAT inspection. Needs investigation with engineering before AC can be written for this portion.
